title: Electrical Machines 1
objectives:
Comprehend the process of converting electromechanical energy and electrical machines as energy
convertors.
Analyze generators of direct current, working principles, characteristics, and applications
syllabus:
Magnetic circuits
Magnetic field energy
Electromagnetic conversion of force and torque in electromagnetic systems
DC machines
Machine construction
Review and determination of electromotive force (EMF)
Various types of windings
Armature reaction
Compensating windings
Types of machine excitations
No-load and on load conditions of DC machines and their characterizations (Generator, motor and
brake conditions)
Starting and control of RPM of DC motors
Loss and efficiency of machines
Parallel connection of DC generators
Various applications of DC machines
textbooks:
1. Electric machinery:Fitzgerald & Kingsley & Umans
2. Electric machines:Selemon & Straughen
3. Electric machinery fundamentals:S.T.Chapman
4. Analysis of Electric machinery:P.C.Krause
5. Direct Current Machines:M.G.Say
